name: Summit AZ - Rank Math Fix Steps 2026-10-08
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Step-by-step Rank Math fixes drawn from the Local SEO and AI SEO lessons, written for Kim to apply in WP Admin (Rank Math 1.0.280 free). Claude only ran read-only checks.

# What the live check found (Oct 8)
- Rank Math Local SEO: address, phone, email, geo and description all empty; the sitewide Plumber node had only name, URL, logo and hours.
- No sameAs social profiles.
- Pages default schema = Article for all pages, so service and city pages claimed to be articles by a person.
- llms.txt returned 404; Rank Math's LLMS Txt module was off (Alphalete and Pipeliners already had one).
- No self-serving review stars (good). robots.txt default, no AI crawlers blocked.

# Steps
- Backup first (Rank Math Status & Tools), one step at a time, purge SG cache after each save.
- Step 1: fill Local SEO business details (address, phone, email, hours, description of approved claims only).
- Step 2: social profiles. Step 3: change the default Pages schema. Step 4: enable llms.txt.
- Approval gate: steps 1 to 3 change schema business details and the homepage output, so they need Scott's OK; step 4 needs Kim (Scott FYI). A draft message to Scott is included.

# Decisions and status
- Oct 7 to 8: Kim chose "only llms.txt for now"; LLMS Txt enabled for Pages and Posts.
- Oct 9: default Pages schema set to None (via the schema audit fixes).
- Oct 22: Local SEO address, phone and sameAs added. The phone used was the GBP number (480) 470-8706, not the 447-7008 proposed here, per [Summit AZ - Homepage GBP Alignment 2026-10-21](lib:brain-summit-az-homepage-gbp-alignment-2026-10-21). "LLC" removed from the name per Scott; YouTube confirmed and added.
